reviews_verbatim.author: Tana Sauder
reviews_verbatim.text: Very happy with grooming.  Not only do they give my Maltese a great cut they are really nice to him.  They get him in and out in a reasonable time and he always looks great!!

reviews_verbatim.author: Sarah Frederick
reviews_verbatim.text: Both groomers are sweet loving, caring and most of all, compassionate to all the fur babies who walk into their shop! They remember your dog and their cut. I've never had anything to complain about!

reviews_verbatim.author: amber price
reviews_verbatim.text: She is amazing!! My grandma always brought her dogs here when I was a kid, and I will not take my dogs anywhere else now. Amazing price, service, etc

reviews_verbatim.author: Christine “Chrissy” Peltier
reviews_verbatim.text: Called around needing a nail trim for my 8-month-old puppy, and Pup Hut was the only place willing to fit her in, same day. Unfortunately, my babygirl proceeded to snap at the groomer, so I had to hold her through the service. The groomer …
